purpose: Freeze primary-paper headline claims and prohibited promotions before protected outcomes are accessed. This is not a result ledger.

claims.claim: Scientific problems can have structurally relevant remote parents that lexical/domain-local search may fail to surface.
claims.boundary: does not show the proposed machine method finds them better

claims.claim: A donor-faithful pipeline can be defined that separates native reconstruction, decision-preserving reduction, structural relation witnessing, counter-probes and target recovery.
The integrated method improves remote-parent discovery or correct novelty contraction over the strongest information-matched parent composition.
The integrated method constitutes a novel standalone scientific method contribution.

prohibited_promotions: do not write Results performance without protected outcomes
do not call expert-reconstructed ground truth machine-generated
do not equate analogy count with scientific utility

claims.claim: Scientific sameness/comparability is relation- and context-dependent rather than captured safely by one universal similarity metric.
A common typed receipt can expose relation kind, context, preserved judgments, loss/error, counter-probes and expiry without replacing parent-native semantics.
The shared interface yields protected cross-parent scientific decisions that strongest parent-specific compositions do not.
Relation refinement/composition/selective-reopening laws hold generally for the proposed interface.

prohibited_promotions: do not call a schema a theory result
do not flatten exact/approximate/observational/causal relations into one equivalence
do not call an internal proof sketch a theorem

claims.claim: Scientific problem solving can be modeled as control over unresolved obligations and plural scientific state rather than as one mandatory serial workflow.
The candidate solver preserves frozen V1 capabilities under matched non-compensatory parity evaluation.
The candidate solver improves justified scientific outcomes over the strongest donor-composed adaptive solver without increasing false completion or over-escalation.
Minimum sufficient escalation is a stable measurable principle across problem domains.
required_evidence: domain-independent or explicitly domain-relative partial order

prohibited_promotions: do not strawman current agentic science as fixed pipelines
do not call orchestration success scientific completion
do not promote J0-J8 labels as universal natural kinds

claims.claim: Counts of supporting sources or validators can overstate evidence when support is statistically or structurally dependent.
Evaluator validity can change when deployment/optimization alters the generating environment.
A unified dependence/dynamic-evaluation interface improves calibration or prevents false scientific authority beyond strongest dependence + provenance + performative parents.
Dependence and performativity form one general scientific assurance object.
required_evidence: common formal conditional-validity representation or empirically shared decision effect

prohibited_promotions: do not infer independence from distinct agent identities
do not treat unknown dependence as known independence
do not imply statistics creates institutional authority
do not flag all evaluators as performative

claims.claim: Scientific opportunity value is not identical to textual novelty, surprise or diversity.
A source-bound prospective opportunity object can be defined before future outcomes.
The proposed opportunity process prospectively identifies more scientifically valuable questions than strongest problem-finding/expert parents.
P-E deserves a standalone paper in the current ORION-V2 closeout.

prohibited_promotions: do not retrospectively label successful questions as prospectively valuable
do not optimize opportunity criterion after future outcomes
do not use novelty score as scientific importance
